title: Shoes and Bills
body:
This mod adds the bird called the Shoebill stork or the Balaeniceps rex. It sounds like a machine gun and can peck your face off if you attack. I recommend playing this with the [Sound Physics Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) Oh and I should mention theres a 10% chance of the bird dropping a Shoe-Bill that does something awesome! 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

All you can do with the bill is eat it with no nutritional value and thats it...

</details>
